# wso2is_cors_configuration (Resource)

Manages the CORS settings of the server's endpoints. The allowed origins come from the `oidc.allowed_origins` setting of each application. The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the settings keep their current values, and Terraform stops managing them. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `cors_configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_cors_configuration" "this" {
  supports_credentials = true
  max_age              = 3600
  exposed_headers      = ["Location"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_any_origin` (Boolean) Allow every origin (not recommended).
- `allow_generic_http_requests` (Boolean) Let non-CORS requests through.
- `allow_subdomains` (Boolean) Allow subdomains of the allowed origins.
- `exposed_headers` (Set of String) Response headers exposed to browsers.
- `max_age` (Number) Preflight cache lifetime in seconds (`-1` = not set).
- `support_any_header` (Boolean) Allow every request header.
- `supported_headers` (Set of String) Request headers allowed when `support_any_header` is off.
- `supported_methods` (Set of String) HTTP methods allowed in CORS requests.
- `supports_credentials` (Boolean) Allow credentials (cookies, authorization headers).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `cors_configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_cors_configuration.this cors_configuration
```
